flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/list/{NoticeSearchOutstandingList,NoticeSearchAllList}. ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_management/retrieval/getnotice/{GetNoticeServiceImpl,mapper/NoticeResponseMapper} (plus-offence-notice). Other repos: no related code
note: Status in stories.json: 'Requirement given - Gen flow' (no flow deck). The Outstanding list shows vehicle no. and amount payable. Suspension details (type, reason) exist only in the All Notices list, not in the Outstanding list. The PLUS endpoint /v1/plus-offence-notice returns vehicleNo, amountPayable, suspensionType, eprReasonOfSuspension and the suspended list when suspendedIndicator = Y; the PLUS screen that uses it: cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket touches this display.
recommendation: Claim vehicle number and amount payable. Claim suspension details only partially: they are not in the Outstanding list.

steps.step: The result list shows the vehicle number of each notice
steps.detail: The vehicle_no column exists in the Outstanding list (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:172). The /v1/plus-offence-notice response also carries vehicleNo (NoticeResponseMapper.java:81).

steps.step: The result list shows the current amount payable of each notice
steps.detail: The amount_payable column exists in the Outstanding list (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:178). The /v1/plus-offence-notice response carries amountPayable (NoticeResponseMapper.java:83).

steps.step: The result list shows the existing suspension details
steps.detail: The Outstanding list has no suspension type or reason column (columns at NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:160-182). Those columns exist only in the All Notices list (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:162,164). In the API, /v1/plus-offence-notice returns suspensionType (NoticeResponseMapper.java:79) and, when suspendedIndicator = Y, the suspended notice list (GetNoticeServiceImpl.java:53-54,63-68; NoticeResponseMapper.java:95-98); the PLUS screen that shows it: cannot verify from repo.
